gen-dafont-starborn-gf-savate: Wispy, spaced-out stars. Savate follows with a tall rounded o and open curves, and its crossbars run a touch finer than its stems, which gives the pair a crisp, lived-in finish.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Dreamy letters drift apart in Starborn, leaving a dark stripe of lowercase through each line, while Schibsted Grotesk keeps wide-open bowls and terminals. Shrink the heading and that stripe turns to mush.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-sen: Ethereal and widely spaced, Starborn floats above Sen, whose tall lowercase is traced by one unbroken line with curves that stop before turning inward. Give Sen a little extra size.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-sintony: Starborn's gaping gaps between letters and its dark band of lowercase make it the odd one out, drifting like a dream across each line. And Sintony grounds it with a chunky, tall midzone and curves that never clog.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-sofia-sans: Starborn scatters its letters wide, with a heavy dark stripe of lowercase running through every line. And Sofia Sans answers with wirelike strokes of one thickness, rounded forms with an open side, and tall stencil-cut lowercase.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-sofia-sans-semi-c: Sofia Sans Semi Condensed has lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. Starborn's dreamy, widely spaced stripe of letters would crowd and blur if shrunk, while this body keeps channel-like curves that never thin at the turns, with generous entrances.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-sono: Starborn drifts, ethereal and gappy. Sono keeps wide default spacing and tall lowercase with ajar a shapes, so enlarge the body text a notch and let it breathe beside the heading.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-stack-sans-headli: Stack Sans Headline has wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp, a deep middle band, and a pen-like line of constant weight. Starborn dreams with its spaced-out dark lowercase, and the plain sans does the practical talking.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-stack-sans-notch: Stack Sans Notch reads open and big-bodied, its curves easy to see into and its lines like rod stock throughout. A longer passage would feel smooth under Starborn's dreamy heading.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-stack-sans-text: Starborn spaces its letters out wide, with a thick, dark lowercase stripe running through each line like a dream. Stack Sans Text steps in with a marker-like constant line and big-bodied letters.
